name: Abus Granit Detecto X-Plus 8008 Alarm Disc Lock
source_title: Abus Granit Detecto X-Plus 8008 Alarm Disc Lock
description: Abus Granit Detecto X+ 8008 Alarm Disc Lock • 16mm steel bolt (0.63"). • 100dB+ alarm, sounds for 20 seconds, then cycles off until disturbed again. • 60mm throat (2.36"). • Lock can be safely transported in locked position without arming or activating thanks to the automatic brake disc recognition system.
source_description_html:
Abus Granit Detecto X+ 8008 Alarm Disc Lock

The Abus Detecto X Plus 8008 Alarm Disc Lock is made from temper hardened steel and is compact yet easy to use and houses 3D alarm technology. You've heard horror stories about alarms going off unnecessarily and having to wear ear plugs to replace the battery. Not so with ABUS disk locks. The 8008 uses an automatic brake disc recognition system, meaning that the alarm will not arm unless it is mounted onto the brake disc itself. You can carry this lock in your pocket or bag and it will not arm or sound.

Features:

  • 16mm steel bolt (0.63")
  • 100dB+ alarm, sounds for 20 seconds, then cycles off until disturbed again
  • 60mm throat (2.36")
  • Lock can be safely transported in locked position without arming or activating thanks to the automatic brake disc recognition system
  • Alarm only arms on the disc
  • Different acoustic signals inform let the user know about battery life, activation and armed status
  • ABUS X-Plus cylinder for the highest protection against manipulation and picking
  • Two keys supplied with lock, one LED lighted
  • ABUS Code Card for easy replacement/additional key ordering
  • One CR2 battery for the alarm included
  • Can be keyed alike with other X-Plus Cylinder locks
  • Includes a carrying case for easy transport on the bike

name: Abus Granit Detecto X-Plus 8077 Alarm Disc Lock
source_title: Abus Granit Detecto X-Plus 8077 Alarm Disc Lock
description: Abus Granit Detecto X+ 8077 Alarm Disk Lock • 13mm steel bolt. • 48mm throat. • The bolt, lock body as well as supporting elements of the locking mechanism are made of special hardened steel. • Alarm function on basis of the ABUS 3D detection system that means that every movement is detected.
source_description_html:
Abus Granit Detecto X+ 8077 Alarm Disk Lock

You've invested in a valuable motorcycle, don't leave it unprotected. The ABUS Granit Dectecto X-Plus 8077 is as state of the art as the machine you drive. Made of special temper hardened steel, the deceptively simple looking lock is incredibly easy to use but houses a high tech 3D alarm sensor technology wrapped in a brick of steel.

Features:

  • 13mm steel bolt
  • 48mm throat
  • The bolt, lock body as well as supporting elements of the locking mechanism are made of special hardened steel
  • Alarm function on basis of the ABUS 3D detection system that means that every movement is detected
  • Alarm is at least 100 dB
  • Lock can be transported in locked condition without activated detection system thanks to automatic brake disc recognition system
  • A multi colour LED and different acoustic signals inform about battery, activation and alarm status
  • ABUS X-Plus cylinder for highest protection against manipulations, e.g. picking
  • Two keys are supplied with the lock, one LED lighted
  • Two AAA standard batteries for the alarm function are included
  • Protective bag included

name: Abus Granit Extreme Plus 59 Chain Lock
source_title: Abus Granit Extreme Plus 59 Chain Lock
description: Abus Granit Extreme Plus 59 Chain Lock • 12 mm strong chain with fabric sleeve to prevent damage to the motorbike's paintwork. • Special hardened chain protects against theft from even the most aggressive mechanical attacks. • Chain link locks directly into lock. • Extreme resistance against pulling link out of lock.
source_description_html:
Abus Granit Extreme Plus 59 Chain Lock

The Granit Extreme Plus employs the most high-tech, patented security features available and is the burliest and strongest of all motorcycle chain locks in the ABUS line-up. Boasting the highest security rating Abus uses, this lock offers excellent protection in areas of high theft risk and comes in a variety of lengths to meet all of your security needs.

Features:

  • 12 mm strong chain with fabric sleeve to prevent damage to the motorbike's paintwork
  • Special hardened chain protects against theft from even the most aggressive mechanical attacks
  • Chain link locks directly into lock
  • Extreme resistance against pulling link out of lock
  • Abus X-Plus locking system includes more than one million key variations
  • ABUS Power Link Technology (patented) offers a direct and covered locking of the chain into the locking mechanism
  • The chain, the lock body as well as supporting elements of the locking mechanism are made of special hardened steel
  • ABUS X-Plus cylinder for highest protection against manipulations e.g. picking
  • Two keys are supplied with the lock, one LED torch key
  • Manually operated keyhole cover against dirt and corrosion
  • 4700g (10.4 pounds)
